add_namespace = COLDWAR_TUR_D8

# IMPERIA COLD WAR — 24.11.2026: invitation to the Developing Eight founded by Turkey (offer event, like MD).
# ROOT = invited country, FROM = Turkey. Generated by tools/deal_offers/tur_d8_offers.py.
country_event = {
	id = COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1
	title = COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1.t
	desc = COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1.d
	picture = GFX_political_deal
	is_triggered_only = yes

	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1.a
		trigger = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_invited }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { factor = 0 has_war_with = FROM }
			modifier = { factor = 0.2 has_opinion = { target = FROM value < -25 } }
			modifier = { factor = 3 has_opinion = { target = FROM value > 49 } }
		}
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1 option a"
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_invited
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_idea = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_membership } } add_ideas = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_membership }
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_TUR_D8.2 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1.b
		trigger = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_invited }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
		log = "[GetDateText]: [Root.GetName]: event COLDWAR_TUR_D8.1 option b"
		clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_invited
		FROM = { country_event = { id = COLDWAR_OFFER.1 days = 1 } }
	}
	option = {
		name = COLDWAR_OFFER_lapsed
		trigger = { NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_TUR_1970_d8_invited } }
		ai_chance = { base = 1 }
	}
}
